name: Cobblestone Stepped Pyramid
description: A small solid stepped pyramid of cobblestone, 7x7 at the base and four tiers high, each tier inset by one block. A monument with no interior or entrance. Adapted from github.com/rkhazh/jevcraft data/schematics (MIT, (c) 2026 Matt Rubens): stairs and slabs as full blocks, doors as an open doorway.
